name: @activepieces/piece-polydoc
description: Convert HTML or a URL to PDF, capture screenshots, and generate EU e-invoices (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD).

auth.description:
Get an API key from the PolyDoc dashboard (dashboard.polydoc.tech, API Keys). It is sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

Turn on **Sandbox** to test against sandbox quota (output is watermarked). Leave it off for production conversions.

apiKey.description: Your PolyDoc API key from dashboard.polydoc.tech.

convert_to_pdf.name: convert_to_pdf
convert_to_pdf.description: Convert HTML, a URL, or a saved template to a PDF.

options.label: Template (render a saved PolyDoc template by ID)

source.description: The URL, inline HTML, or saved template ID, matching the Source Type above.

templateData.description: Data passed to the Liquid template renderer (used only when Source Type is Template).

pageRanges.description: Pages to include, e.g. "1-5, 8". Empty means all pages.

outline.description: Generate PDF bookmarks from HTML headings.

marginTop.description: Top margin with optional unit, e.g. 10mm, 1cm, 0.5in.

deliveryMode.description: How the generated file is returned

options.label: Cloud Storage (upload to a presigned URL)
Webhook (deliver the file to a URL)

presignedUrl.description: HTTP PUT presigned URL from your storage provider (required for Cloud Storage delivery).

webhookUrl.description: URL the generated file is delivered to (required for Webhook delivery).

webhookOptions.description: Extra webhook settings merged with the URL: async, method, headers, retries, retryDelay, timeout.

tag.description: Label for logging and analytics (max 30 characters).

advanced.description: Raw fields deep-merged into the request body for any API option not exposed above (e.g. pdf.watermark, pdf.pdfa, render, request).

aiMetadata.description: Converts a URL, an inline HTML string, or a saved PolyDoc template into a PDF and returns the file (or delivers it to cloud storage / a webhook). Use it to render documents like invoices, reports, or contracts. Idempotent: the same input yields the same PDF.

capture_screenshot.name: capture_screenshot
capture_screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot of a URL, inline HTML, or a saved template.

outputEncoding.description: Return the image as a file (default) or as a base64 string.

tag.description: Label for logging and analytics (max 30 characters).

aiMetadata.description: Captures a screenshot (PNG, JPEG, or WebP) of a URL, an inline HTML string, or a saved PolyDoc template. Supports full-page capture, custom viewport, and base64 or file output. Idempotent: the same input yields the same image.

generate_einvoice.name: generate_einvoice
generate_einvoice.description: Generate a hybrid e-invoice PDF (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD, EN 16931) from a visual layout plus structured invoice data.

options.label: Template (render a saved PolyDoc template by ID)

source.description: The URL, inline HTML, or saved template ID, matching the Source Type above.

templateData.description: Data passed to the Liquid template renderer (used only when Source Type is Template).

standard.description: The hybrid e-invoice standard to embed.

profile.description: The data granularity profile to validate against.

invoice.description: Structured invoice data: number, dates, currency, seller, buyer, lines, totals. EN 16931 needs payment terms (or due date), seller taxId for VAT category S, and consistent totals. See docs.polydoc.tech.

verify.description: Validate PDF/A and e-invoice compliance (returns an error if it fails).

deliveryMode.description: How the generated file is returned

Webhook (deliver the file to a URL)

presignedUrl.description: HTTP PUT presigned URL from your storage provider (required for Cloud Storage delivery).

webhookUrl.description: URL the generated file is delivered to (required for Webhook delivery).

webhookOptions.description: Extra webhook settings merged with the URL: async, method, headers, retries, retryDelay, timeout.

tag.description: Label for logging and analytics (max 30 characters).

advanced.description: Raw fields deep-merged into the request body for any API option not exposed above (e.g. pdf.watermark, pdf.pdfa, render, request).

aiMetadata.description: Generates a hybrid e-invoice PDF (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD, EN 16931) by embedding structured invoice XML into a visual PDF layout. EN 16931 requires payment terms or a due date, a seller tax ID for VAT category S, and consistent totals. Idempotent: the same input yields the same PDF.
